To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) a combination of natural-language processing and machine learning methods is a viable approach to extracting structured representations of financial transactions from a large news collection; 2) the proposed approach achieves 25% improvement over baselines; and 3) the proposed approach can be applied to other types of structured knowledge bases.

(i) we can extract a structured representation of a given economic event from a large corpus by using a combination of NLP and machine learning methods; (ii) the extracted representation includes all attributes of the given event, and (iii) we can rank these attributes by the associated confidence levels, thus allowing for semi-automatic population and querying of a financial knowledge-base.

(1) we developed a system for automatic extraction of economic events, (2) we demonstrated its effectiveness on a large collection of news articles, and (3) the extracted knowledge is of high quality, and can be used in various data mining and analysis tasks.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the extraction of structured information from unstructured data sources.
the extraction of financial information from news articles and its integration into a financial knowledge base.
the problem of building knowledge bases of financial events from a large collection of textual documents.
